info.title: AgentAI private account API
info.description: Account API (invite-only, or self-sign-up with owner approval when the owner opens it). Everything a replacement front end needs: /v1/csrf, /auth/*, /v1/app, then the resource endpoints. See UI_CONTRACT.md. Customer execution is live when features.execution is true.
